extName.description: Extension name in the Chrome Web Store (max 75 characters)

extDescription.message: 保存当前 Instagram 页面中的图片、视频、Reels 和快拍，也能在 ig.tools 免登录打开链接。

placeholder.description: Popup input placeholder, same wording as the site field

helper.message: 仅限公开内容，无需登录 Instagram。
helper.description: Line under the popup input, same wording as the site

invalidInput.message: 请输入 Instagram 链接或 @用户名。
invalidInput.description: Shown when the popup input is not an Instagram link or username

menuOpenLink.description: Context menu on an Instagram link

menuOpenPage.message: 用 ig.tools 打开此页面
menuOpenPage.description: Context menu on an Instagram page

download.description: Accessible name of each file's download button

saved.description: Accessible name of a download button after the file was saved

downloadFailed.description: Shown when Chrome could not start a download

loading.message: 正在查找此页面的媒体…
loading.description: Shown while the popup reads the open Instagram page

notMediaPage.message: 在 Instagram 打开帖子、Reel、快拍或个人主页后，点击 ig.tools 图标即可保存媒体。
notMediaPage.description: Shown on Instagram pages without a post, Reel, Story or profile

browseOnSite.message: 在 ig.tools 浏览此账号
browseOnSite.description: Link on an Instagram profile page that opens the account on ig.tools

openOnSite.description: Link under an error that opens the same page on ig.tools

loginNeeded.message: 在此浏览器登录 Instagram 后即可从此页面保存，或免登录在 ig.tools 查看。
loginNeeded.description: Shown when the browser is not signed in to Instagram

unavailable.message: 此帖子或快拍为私密、已删除或已无法查看。
unavailable.description: Shown for private, deleted or expired content

failed.message: Instagram 没有响应，请稍后再试。
failed.description: Shown when Instagram returned an error or did not respond

photoLabel.description: Accessible name of a photo in the grid; $NUMBER$ is its position

videoLabel.description: Accessible name of a video in the grid; $NUMBER$ is its position

currentStories.description: Popup heading above an account's current Stories, listed from its profile page

noStories.description: Shown on a profile page when the account has no current Stories

tabStories.description: Profile popup tab: the account's current Stories

tabHighlights.description: Profile popup tab: the account's Highlights

tabAvatar.description: Profile popup tab and image label: the account's profile picture

back.description: Button that returns from one Highlight to the Highlights list

noHighlights.description: Shown when the account has no Highlights

avatarOnSite.message: 在 ig.tools 获取原尺寸头像
avatarOnSite.description: Link that opens the ig.tools profile picture downloader for this account

avatarSmall.message: Instagram 目前没有返回原尺寸头像，这是较小的版本。
avatarSmall.description: Shown under the profile picture when only the small version was returned

avatarUnavailable.description: Shown when no profile picture could be loaded

pageButtons.message: 在 Instagram 显示下载按钮
pageButtons.description: Popup switch that turns the on-page download buttons on or off

pageButtonsHelp.message: 在帖子、主页网格、快拍和 Reels 上添加下载按钮。
pageButtonsHelp.description: Help under the on-page buttons switch in settings

pageButtonTitle.description: Tooltip and accessible name of a download button on instagram.com

pageButtonFailed.description: Tooltip of an on-page button after the download failed; a detail may follow in brackets

pageButtonSlide.description: Label of the carousel slide button; $CURRENT$ is the slide on screen, $TOTAL$ the number of slides

pageButtonAll.description: Label of a carousel post's action-row button; $COUNT$ is the number of slides

formTitle.description: Title above the link field on pages without media

select.description: Accessible name prefix of a card's select control, followed by the item name

itemCount.description: How many items there are (2 or more)

onePhoto.description: Shown when the page has a single photo

oneVideo.description: Shown when the page has a single video

downloadSelected.description: Main button: save the selected items

downloadPhoto.description: Main button for a single photo

downloadVideo.description: Main button for a single video

downloadAvatar.description: Main button for the profile picture

savesTo.description: Line under the main button naming the download folder

openOnSiteFooter.message: 在 ig.tools 打开 · 无需登录
openOnSiteFooter.description: Link at the bottom of the popup on Instagram pages

kindPost.description: Kind of page, shown under the username

kindReel.description: Kind of page, shown under the username

kindStory.description: Kind of page, shown under the username

kindHighlight.description: Kind of page, shown under the username

kindProfile.description: Kind of page, shown under the username

storiesNote.message: 在这里保存快拍，不会出现在观看者名单中。
storiesNote.description: Note under Stories listed on a profile page (tested in October 2026)

shortcutHelp.description: Describes the shortcut; $KEYS$ is the key combination

shortcutNotSet.description: Shown when Chrome left the shortcut unset

shortcutSet.description: Link to Chrome's shortcut settings when no shortcut is set

folderAccount.description: Folder option: a folder per account with posts, stories and highlights subfolders

folderOne.message: 全部放进 ig.tools 文件夹
folderOne.description: Folder option: every file in one ig.tools folder

folderDownloads.description: Folder option: every file straight in the Downloads folder

highlightsNote.message: 在这里保存精选快拍，不会出现在观看者名单中。
highlightsNote.description: Note under Highlights listed on a profile page (tested in October 2026)
